patient_history: Patient is a 54-year-old male presenting with a 3-day history of chest pain radiating to the left arm, accompanied by shortness of breath and diaphoresis. He has a past medical history of hypertension and type 2 diabetes mellitus, both managed with oral medications. He reports smoking one pack of cigarettes per day for 20 years. ECG showed ST-segment elevation in leads II, III, and aVF. Troponin levels were elevated. Patient was admitted for suspected inferior wall myocardial infarction and taken for emergency cardiac catheterization.
reference_summary: 54-year-old male with hypertension, diabetes, and smoking history presented with chest pain and dyspnea; ECG and troponin findings indicated inferior MI, and he underwent emergency cardiac catheterization.
